title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
content: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

title: MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted
content: Bitcoin Magazine MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted MSCI publishes its November index review at 5 p.m. ET, the first under a new non-operating company screen. Its potential list, built on Sept. 30 filings, already marks Strategy, Metaplanet and three others as Deleted. This post MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22
content: Bitcoin Magazine Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22 A Bank of Russia ordinance published Wednesday lets exchanges start organized crypto trading on Nov. 22, but only after the central bank approves their rules. Moscow Exchange still aims for Dec. 1. This post Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Deutsche Bank Switches On Bitcoin Custody for Paying Clients
